data.title: Hop Along the Number Line
data.description: Learn how to add numbers within 20 by counting on using a number line.

challenges.instruction: Put your finger on the starting spot at 0. Make 1 big hop to the right and see where you land!
challenges.hint: Start at zero and count one hop to the right to find your new spot.

challenges.instruction: Put your finger on the number 3. Make 1 big hop to the right to see where you land!
challenges.hint: Start at 3 and count just 1 hop forward to find your new number.

challenges.instruction: Put your finger on 4. Hop backward 3 spaces to the left and see where you land!
challenges.hint: Count the hops one by one as you move backward: 1, 2, 3!

challenges.instruction: Put your finger on 10, and hop back 5 spaces to the left to find out where you land!
challenges.hint: Try counting backward one step at a time as you move your finger 5 spaces to the left.
